tasks.title: Install autonomous roadmap, CI, E2E harness and orchestration
acceptance: CI validates storefront, dependencies, ledger and browser smoke tests
Codex workflow selects one dependency-ready task and opens a scoped PR
Operations documentation lists credentials and safety limits

tasks.title: Catalog, search, product details and persistent demo cart
acceptance: PR #6 CI is green
Review confirms no Shopify runtime and no live-commerce claims
PR #6 is merged into vps-migration

tasks.title: Record ADRs and provisional first-party API contracts
acceptance: ADRs cover URLs, system of record, sessions, cart identity, checkout ownership, caching and deployment
Versioned schemas define errors, pagination, money, timestamps and idempotency
Unapproved business decisions remain explicit blockers rather than invented defaults

tasks.title: Complete approved shared UI fidelity and feedback primitives
acceptance: Header menu focus, Escape, outside click and scroll behavior pass desktop/mobile tests
Footer exposes only Facebook, Instagram, Threads and Telegram
Reusable Ukrainian loading, error, empty and toast primitives are covered by accessibility tests
tasks.blocker: Pixel parity remains blocked until approved screenshots and merchant settings are supplied.

tasks.title: Bootstrap first-party API service and health endpoints
acceptance: Typed API application starts without production credentials
Liveness and dependency-aware readiness endpoints are tested
Structured logs redact secrets and personal data
CI runs API lint, typecheck, tests and build

tasks.title: Add PostgreSQL schema, migrations and isolated integration tests
acceptance: Forward-only migrations cover users, catalog, carts, orders, wishlist, reviews, addresses and messages
Constraints and indexes enforce ownership and idempotency invariants
Integration tests run against disposable PostgreSQL
Backup/restore expectations are documented

tasks.title: Implement catalog and search API adapters
acceptance: Catalog, categories, product details, facets and Ukrainian search satisfy shared contracts
Price and availability remain server-authoritative
Mock and HTTP adapters pass the same contract suite
Timeout, invalid payload and unavailable dependency states are tested
tasks.blocker: F3 public reads and opt-in transport implemented; catalog source/import and visual-domain mapping remain owner decisions. No live UI switch.

tasks.title: Implement server-backed cart and inventory reconciliation
acceptance: Guest cart identity and authenticated merge are explicit
Every mutation reconciles price, inventory and totals
Mutations are idempotent and reject invalid quantities
Storefront handles stale inventory and API failures without false success
tasks.blocker: F4 isolated sessions/CSRF prove an actor; cart HTTP still has no success handler. Product owner must approve current-cart creation/selection and guest/merge policy; live SMS/session rollout remains blocked.

tasks.title: Implement promotions and authoritative discount calculations
acceptance: Promotion validity and amounts are calculated server-side
Apply/remove/conflict/expiry states are tested
Promotional surfaces preserve approved BAZAR styling
No client-only discount can alter authoritative totals
tasks.blocker: Promotion rules and ownership require business approval before production readiness.

tasks.title: Build approved three-step checkout UI and service boundary
acceptance: Exactly three approved Ukrainian steps are implemented
Нова пошта and Meest are represented while BAZAR pickup remains disabled
Back/forward preserves validated state
Confirmation cannot claim payment or order creation without a live adapter

tasks.title: Integrate delivery quote and shipment provider boundaries
acceptance: Provider-neutral contract validates cities, branches, quotes and timeouts
Provider outages and stale quotes have truthful recovery states
Secrets remain server-only
Production mode fails closed without configured providers
tasks.blocker: Нова пошта and Meest credentials, commercial terms and approved service selection are required.

tasks.title: Build approved phone-only identity UI and typed service boundary
acceptance: Responsive header modal and login/register routes expose only the approved phone flow
Ukrainian phone validation and six-position OTP keyboard, paste, focus, resend and overflow behavior pass desktop/mobile tests
Registration consent plus loading, invalid, expired, rate-limit, resend and network states are accessible
Preview sends no SMS, creates no session or auth flag, exposes no protected data, and persists or logs no OTP or complete phone number

tasks.title: Build approved demo profile and account interface
acceptance: The /profile overview and exact nine-entry desktop/mobile navigation contain no Overview item, and drawer focus, Escape, focus return and overflow checks pass

Orders, wishlist, reviews, personal data, addresses and payment-method screens expose deterministic demo, loading, empty, validation and error states without claiming authenticated persistence or verified commerce facts
Wishlist add-to-cart uses the existing cart domain, account mutations remain preview-only, and payment UI never collects or persists PAN or CVV
Messages and support remain explicit Phase E2 shells, while logout truthfully states that no server session exists
Typed service boundaries, unit tests and desktop/mobile Playwright tests pass while IdentityService remains anonymous

tasks.title: Implement phone OTP identity and secure session boundary
acceptance: Only phone OTP authentication is offered
Challenges expire and enforce replay, attempt and rate limits
Sessions use secure HttpOnly cookies with CSRF protection
Demo OTP is visibly isolated and impossible in production mode
PII and OTP values are redacted from logs
tasks.blocker: F4 mechanisms are test-isolated. Real SMS/provider credentials, production keys/TTL/rate/consent/retention policies and BFF/TLS activation require owner approval; no live UI switch.

tasks.title: Implement authorized profile shell, personal data and logout
acceptance: Sidebar order exactly matches approved audit and contains no Overview item
Unauthorized routes follow the approved OTP flow
Mobile drawer focus, Escape and overflow pass
Profile mutation rollback, phone re-verification and server logout are tested

tasks.title: Implement customer addresses
acceptance: Create, edit, delete and default-address operations enforce ownership
Ukrainian validation and delivery-provider fields are tested
Loading, empty, validation, conflict and unavailable states are accessible

tasks.title: Implement synchronized wishlist and favorites preview
acceptance: Wishlist persists per authorized user
Guest merge and conflicts are deterministic
Header count, preview, profile list and product controls stay synchronized
Bulk remove and add-to-cart errors do not claim success

tasks.title: Implement order placement transaction and approved checkout confirmation
acceptance: Order placement is idempotent and transactional
Server revalidates cart, inventory, delivery and totals
Failure never renders a success confirmation
Audit trail contains no sensitive payment or OTP data
tasks.blocker: Legal order terms, numbering, fiscalization and inventory ownership require business approval.

tasks.title: Implement customer order list and verified order details
acceptance: Only current-user orders are accessible
Pagination, status filters, empty/error/loading and details are tested
Only authoritative delivery, payment, tracking and timeline fields render
No legacy fallback facts are presented as real

tasks.title: Implement verified-purchase reviews and moderation states
acceptance: Purchase eligibility and ownership are server-enforced
Create, edit, delete and moderation states are explicit
Upload boundary validates type, size and authorization
Product and profile review views remain consistent
tasks.blocker: Moderation and media-retention policy require approval.

tasks.title: Integrate tokenized payment provider and payment methods
acceptance: Raw card data never touches BAZAR storage or logs
Provider tokens and safe display metadata are server-authorized
Webhook verification and idempotency are tested
Decline, timeout, retry and uncertain outcome states never claim success
tasks.blocker: Payment provider, merchant account, PCI scope and legal approval are required.

tasks.title: Implement authorized support tickets
acceptance: Ticket creation and status access enforce ownership
Validation, attachments, delivery failures and empty states are tested
Retention and PII redaction are documented
tasks.blocker: Support ownership, SLA, attachment and retention policies require approval.

tasks.title: Implement authorized marketplace messaging
acceptance: Conversation access, send, read and pin operations enforce membership
Oldest-to-newest ordering, open-at-bottom, unread-chat count and responsive navigation match approval
Attachment authorization, retry and failure states are tested
No local-only action claims a message was delivered
tasks.blocker: Seller/staff participants, moderation, realtime transport and retention policy require approval.

tasks.title: Define seller and staff system integration boundaries
acceptance: Role and permission matrix is explicit
Seller/staff adapters expose no unapproved customer UI
Webhook/event authentication, replay protection and audit fields are tested
Unavailable external systems degrade safely
tasks.blocker: Seller and staff source systems, owners and SLAs are not yet selected.

tasks.title: Add security controls, observability and operational alerts
acceptance: Threat model covers identity, checkout, messaging and admin boundaries
Rate limits, CSRF, headers and secret validation are tested
Metrics, traces and redacted logs have actionable alerts
Runbooks cover dependency outage and uncertain payment/order state
tasks.blocker: Production monitoring destinations and incident owners require configuration.

tasks.title: Prepare reproducible VPS deployment, backups and rollback
acceptance: Immutable build and least-privilege service definitions are reproducible
TLS, reverse proxy, secrets injection and health checks are documented
PostgreSQL backup and restore are rehearsable
Rollback does not require rewriting history or deleting Shopify source
tasks.blocker: VPS OS, host access, DNS, TLS ownership and backup destination require human authorization.

tasks.title: Complete parity, resilience and release-readiness evidence
acceptance: All Definition of Done release gates have recorded evidence
Desktop/mobile accessibility and approved visual comparisons pass
Critical journeys and dependency failures pass E2E
Backup restore and rollback rehearsal pass
Production deploy and main merge remain separate human-approved actions
tasks.blocker: Requires approved screenshots, credentials, legal/business sign-off and explicit production authorization.
